import polars as pl
import re
from datetime import datetime
import math

NULL_VALUES = ["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null", "NULL", "None"]

def _to_null(col: pl.Expr) -> pl.Expr:
    return pl.when(col.is_in(NULL_VALUES) | col.is_null()).then(None).otherwise(col)

def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return raw.select(
        contact_id=pl.col("Contact ID").str.to_uppercase(),
        full_name=pl.concat_str([pl.col("First Name"), pl.col("Last Name")], separator=" "),
        email=_to_null(pl.col("Email")).str.to_lowercase(),
        phone=_to_null(pl.col("Phone"))
            .str.replace_all(r"[\s\-\(\)]", "")
            .str.replace(r"^0", "+64")
            .str.replace(r"^(?!\+)", "+"),
        company=pl.col("Company"),
        created_on=pl.col("Created").str.to_date(format="%Y-%m-%d", strict=False),
        lifetime_value=pl.col("Lifetime Value").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
    )
